sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers_on_promo_rate`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`promotional_rate_flag` = TRUE

SELECT
  `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` AS `service_tier`,
  ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(`subscription`.`termination_date`, `subscription`.`activation_date`)), 1) AS `average_days_on_last_plan`,
  COUNT(*) AS `cancellations`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`termination_date` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `subscription_plan`.`service_tier`
ORDER BY `average_days_on_last_plan` DESC

WITH `failed_payment_subscribers` AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT `invoice`.`subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`payment` AS `payment`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` AS `invoice`
    ON `payment`.`invoice_id` = `invoice`.`invoice_id`
  WHERE `payment`.`payment_status` = 'Failed'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS `total_cancellations`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `fps`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `cancellations_with_failed_payment_history`,
  try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `fps`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),COUNT(*)) AS `share_with_failed_payment_history`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
LEFT JOIN `failed_payment_subscribers` AS `fps`
  ON `churn_event`.`subscriber_id` = `fps`.`subscriber_id`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `annual_paying_subscribers_up_for_renewal`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`subscription_type` = 'Annual'
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` >= DATE'2026-11-10'
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` < DATE_ADD(DATE'2026-11-10', 60)

WITH `resolution_viewing` AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN `video_resolution` = '4K' THEN '4K' ELSE 'Rest' END AS `resolution_bucket`,
    try_divide(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
  WHERE `video_resolution` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN `video_resolution` = '4K' THEN '4K' ELSE 'Rest' END
),
`total_viewing` AS (
  SELECT SUM(`watch_hours`) AS `total_watch_hours`
  FROM `resolution_viewing`
)
SELECT
  `resolution_bucket`,
  `watch_hours`,
  100.0 * (try_divide(`watch_hours`,`total_watch_hours`)) AS `viewing_percent`
FROM `resolution_viewing`
CROSS JOIN `total_viewing`
ORDER BY `viewing_percent` DESC;

SELECT CASE WHEN `episode_type` = 'Feature' THEN 'Film' WHEN `episode_type` = 'Episode' THEN 'Regular series episode' END AS `content_group`, try_divide(AVG(`runtime_seconds`),60.0) AS `average_length_minutes`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode`
WHERE `episode_type` IN ('Feature', 'Episode')
  AND `episode_type` IS NOT NULL
  AND `runtime_seconds` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `episode_type`
ORDER BY `content_group`

SELECT `series_status`, COUNT(*) AS `series_count`, AVG(`total_season_count`) AS `avg_season_count` FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` WHERE `series_status` IS NOT NULL AND `total_season_count` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `series_status` ORDER BY `series_status`

WITH `subtitle_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `playback_session`.`subtitle_language`,
    COUNT(*) AS `sessions`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`subtitle_language` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `playback_session`.`subtitle_language`
), `ranked_subtitles` AS (
  SELECT
    `subtitle_counts`.`subtitle_language`,
    `subtitle_counts`.`sessions`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `subtitle_counts`.`sessions` DESC) AS `rnk`
  FROM `subtitle_counts`
)
SELECT
  `ranked_subtitles`.`subtitle_language`,
  `ranked_subtitles`.`sessions`
FROM `ranked_subtitles`
WHERE `ranked_subtitles`.`rnk` <= 1
ORDER BY `ranked_subtitles`.`sessions` DESC, `ranked_subtitles`.`subtitle_language`

SELECT campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS past_end, SUM(CASE WHEN start_date > CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_start FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign WHERE campaign_status = 'Live' GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT MIN(end_date) AS mn, MAX(end_date) AS mx, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign WHERE campaign_status = 'Live' LIMIT 1001

SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total_contracted_value) AS gross_value, SUM(net_order_value) AS net_value FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY gross_value DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT 'strategic' AS tier_type, p.strategic_tier AS tier, COUNT(*) AS deals, SUM(d.deal_value_amount) AS total_value, d.currency_code FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner AS p ON d.partner_id = p.partner_id GROUP BY p.strategic_tier, d.currency_code UNION ALL SELECT 'risk', p.risk_tier, COUNT(*), SUM(d.deal_value_amount), d.currency_code FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner AS p ON d.partner_id = p.partner_id GROUP BY p.risk_tier, d.currency_code ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 1001

SELECT p.partner_type, COUNT(*) AS active_exclusive_deals, SUM(CASE WHEN d.deal_expiration_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS past_expiry_date FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner AS p ON d.partner_id = p.partner_id WHERE d.exclusivity_flag = TRUE AND d.deal_status = 'Active' GROUP BY p.partner_type ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(c.last_viewed_title_id) AS with_title, COUNT_IF(NOT c.last_viewed_title_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w WHERE w.title_id = c.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = s.territory_id AND w.active_flag)) AS no_live, COUNT_IF(NOT c.last_viewed_title_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w WHERE w.title_id = c.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = s.territory_id)) AS no_window_at_all, COUNT(DISTINCT c.subscriber_id) AS subs FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.churn_event AS c JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = c.subscriber_id LIMIT 1001

WITH cur AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.subscriber_id FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS p ON s.subscription_plan_id = p.subscription_plan_id WHERE s.subscription_status = 'Active' AND p.plan_type = 'Paid') SELECT COUNT(*) AS impressions_paid_now, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery WHERE delivery_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE)) AS total_oct, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subscriber_id) AS subscribers FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps ON i.playback_session_id = ps.playback_session_id JOIN cur ON ps.subscriber_id = cur.subscriber_id WHERE i.delivery_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

SELECT t.content_type, COUNT(*) AS impressions, SUM(i.cpm_realized) / 1000 AS ad_revenue_usd, SUM(SUM(i.cpm_realized) / 1000) OVER () AS total_rev, COUNT(DISTINCT i.content_episode_id) AS eps, SUM(CASE WHEN e.content_episode_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_episode FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON i.content_episode_id = e.content_episode_id LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title AS t ON e.title_id = t.title_id GROUP BY t.content_type ORDER BY ad_revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT t.territory_group AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subscriber_id) AS unique_viewers, COUNT(*) AS impressions FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps ON i.playback_session_id = ps.playback_session_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON ps.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON s.territory_id = t.territory_id WHERE i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY t.territory_group ORDER BY unique_viewers DESC LIMIT 1001

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`subtotal_amount` - `discount_amount`) AS `monthly_revenue`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice`
  WHERE `invoice_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `invoice_date` < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', DATE'2026-11-10')
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice_date`)
), ranked_months AS (
  SELECT
    `month`,
    `monthly_revenue`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `monthly_revenue` DESC) AS `revenue_rank`
  FROM monthly_revenue
  WHERE `month` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT `month`, `monthly_revenue`
FROM ranked_months
WHERE `revenue_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `month`

SELECT COUNT(*) AS `active_accounts`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber`
WHERE `account_status` = 'Active'

WITH j AS (SELECT territory_id FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory WHERE name = 'Japan' OR iso_alpha_2_code = 'JP') SELECT 'subscription' AS src, SUM(i.subtotal_amount - i.discount_amount) AS net_ex_tax, SUM(i.total_amount_due) AS billed, SUM(i.amount_paid) AS collected, COUNT(*) AS n FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.invoice AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = i.subscriber_id WHERE s.territory_id IN (SELECT territory_id FROM j) AND i.invoice_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT 'ads', SUM(d.cpm_realized) / 1000, NULL, NULL, COUNT(*) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = d.subscriber_id WHERE s.territory_id IN (SELECT territory_id FROM j) AND d.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND d.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

SELECT try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `total_watch_time_hours`, COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`) AS `playback_sessions`, AVG(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`) AS `average_watch_time_per_session_seconds`, AVG(`playback_session`.`completion_percentage`) AS `completion_rate`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= add_months(TIMESTAMP'2026-11-09 00:00:00', -6)
  AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP'2026-11-10 00:00:00'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(DISTINCT i.playback_session_id) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT p.subscriber_id) AS viewers FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p ON i.playback_session_id = p.playback_session_id WHERE p.platform_type = 'Tablet' AND i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`acquisition_channel` = 'Partner bundle'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(e.content_episode_id) AS matched FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON i.content_episode_id = e.content_episode_id LIMIT 1001

SELECT g.name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS impressions, SUM(i.total_impressions_served) AS served FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON i.content_episode_id = e.content_episode_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.series AS s ON e.content_series_id = s.series_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.genre AS g ON s.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY impressions DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t.name, w.window_type, w.availability_status, w.active_flag, w.blackout_flag, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT title_id) AS titles, MIN(window_open_date) AS mn, MAX(window_close_date) AS mx FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t USING (territory_id) WHERE t.name LIKE '%German%' OR t.iso_alpha_2_code = 'DE' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2, 3, 4, 5 LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT title_id) AS all_active, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT blackout_flag THEN title_id END) AS not_blackout, COUNT(*) AS windows FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t USING (territory_id) WHERE t.iso_alpha_2_code = 'DE' AND window_type = 'SVOD' AND active_flag AND window_open_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND (window_close_date IS NULL OR window_close_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE)) LIMIT 1001

WITH `paid_switches` AS (
  SELECT
    `old_sub`.`subscription_id` AS `old_subscription_id`,
    `new_sub`.`subscription_id` AS `new_subscription_id`,
    `old_plan`.`base_price` AS `old_base_price`,
    `new_plan`.`base_price` AS `new_base_price`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `old_sub`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `new_sub`
    ON `old_sub`.`subscriber_id` = `new_sub`.`subscriber_id`
   AND `old_sub`.`termination_date` = `new_sub`.`activation_date`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `old_plan`
    ON `old_sub`.`subscription_plan_id` = `old_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `new_plan`
    ON `new_sub`.`subscription_plan_id` = `new_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `old_sub`.`subscription_status` = 'Superseded'
    AND `old_sub`.`termination_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `new_sub`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `old_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `new_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
)
SELECT try_divide(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN `new_base_price` < `old_base_price` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),COUNT(*)) AS `downgrade_share_percent`
FROM `paid_switches`

WITH `reason_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
    `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` AS `cancellation_reason_description`,
    COUNT(*) AS `churn_count`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
    ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2025-11-10 00:00:00')
    AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2026-11-10 00:00:00')
    AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
    AND `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    `territory`.`territory_group`,
    `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description`
), `ranked_reasons` AS (
  SELECT
    `region`,
    `cancellation_reason_description`,
    `churn_count`,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY `region`
      ORDER BY `churn_count` DESC, `cancellation_reason_description` ASC
    ) AS `reason_rank`
  FROM `reason_counts`
)
SELECT
  `region`,
  `cancellation_reason_description` AS `top_churn_reason`,
  `churn_count`
FROM `ranked_reasons`
WHERE `reason_rank` <= 1
ORDER BY `region`, `top_churn_reason`;

WITH monthly_collected AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice.invoice_date) AS month,
    SUM(invoice.amount_paid) AS cash_collected
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.invoice AS invoice
  WHERE invoice.invoice_date >= DATE'2026-08-01'
    AND invoice.invoice_date < DATE'2026-11-01'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice.invoice_date)
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(monthly_collected.cash_collected), 2) AS three_month_average_cash_collected
FROM monthly_collected;

WITH monthly_refunds AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `processing_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`amount`) AS `monthly_processed_refund_amount`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`refund`
  WHERE `refund_status` = 'Processed'
    AND `processing_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `processing_date` >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10')
    AND `processing_date` < ADD_MONTHS(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10'), 12)
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `processing_date`)
), running_refunds AS (
  SELECT
    `month`,
    `monthly_processed_refund_amount`,
    SUM(`monthly_processed_refund_amount`) OVER (ORDER BY `month` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `running_total_processed_refunds`
  FROM monthly_refunds
)
SELECT
  `month`,
  `monthly_processed_refund_amount`,
  `running_total_processed_refunds`
FROM running_refunds
WHERE `running_total_processed_refunds` > 100000
ORDER BY `month`
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `mega_fan_members_today`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` = 'Mega Fan'

SELECT (SELECT SUM(cpm_realized) / 1000 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS delivered_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS impressions, (SELECT MIN(delivery_date) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS first_day, (SELECT MAX(delivery_date) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS last_day, (SELECT SUM(total_contracted_value) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order) AS contracted, (SELECT SUM(net_order_value) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order) AS net_contracted LIMIT 1001

SELECT ROUND(SUM(`amount`), 2) AS `total_refunded_amount`, COUNT(*) AS `processed_refund_count`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`refund`
WHERE `refund_status` = 'Processed'

SELECT COUNT(`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions_with_subtitles`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
WHERE `subtitle_language` IS NOT NULL

WITH paying AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.subscriber_id FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS p ON p.subscription_plan_id = s.subscription_plan_id WHERE p.plan_type = 'Paid' AND s.activation_date <= CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) AND (s.termination_date IS NULL OR s.termination_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE))), hrs AS (SELECT subscriber_id, SUM(total_watch_duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS h FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session WHERE session_start_timestamp >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND session_start_timestamp < CAST('2026-11-01' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY subscriber_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS paying_subs, COUNT(hrs.subscriber_id) AS with_viewing, SUM(COALESCE(h, 0)) AS total_hours, AVG(COALESCE(h, 0)) AS avg_hours_all, AVG(h) AS avg_hours_viewers, PERCENTILE_APPROX(COALESCE(h, 0), 0.5) AS median_all FROM paying LEFT JOIN hrs USING (subscriber_id) LIMIT 1001

WITH `studio_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `production_company` AS `studio`,
    COUNT(`series_id`) AS `series_count`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `finale_date` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `still_airing_series_count`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series`
  WHERE `production_company` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `production_company`
), `ranked_studios` AS (
  SELECT
    `studio`,
    `series_count`,
    `still_airing_series_count`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `series_count` DESC) AS `studio_rank`
  FROM `studio_counts`
)
SELECT
  `studio`,
  `series_count`,
  `still_airing_series_count`
FROM `ranked_studios`
WHERE `studio_rank` <= 1
ORDER BY `series_count` DESC, `studio` ASC

  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
